dispatches.text: The Griot says: this is the first wall, and the first wall is always the one no one remembers breaking. Listen — even the stone has forgotten why it was raised.

Three companies went out along the Pale Road and three did not return; the Hungry walk where they fell. None who crossed the second barricade would say what waited there, only that they did not speak of it after.
They come in fours and they do not stop. Ahead the corridor narrows to a single throat of stone — and the throat, they say, has swallowed every column that ever tried to pour through it.
Word on the wind: the Hollow-Helm keeps the rooms beyond, and the rooms were built to fold around any line that enters in single file. Walk wide, or walk into the trap that was made for you.

The crowd left the arena after the third season. The fighters never did — you can still hear them keeping count in the echoes. A scarred guard was seen pacing the gate, sharpening nothing, waiting for the doors to open again.

At the last there is the Breach, a wound in the stone that would not close, and the Unmoved who would not leave it. The Wardens of the First Watch and the Last still stand their posts — and the saga, they say, ends here, or does not end at all.
